ar: كيف حالك؟ كيف هي سنتك الأولى في الجامعة؟
en: How are you doing? How is your first year at university?
questions: Who is the letter written to?
Is it about university life?

ar: أحب العيش في كامبريدج والذهاب إلى معهد ماساتشوستس للتكنولوجيا.
en: I love living in Cambridge and going to MIT.
questions: Where does the student live?
Which university does he attend?

ar: زملائي من جميع أنحاء العالم والأساتذة رائعون.
en: My classmates are from all over the world and the professors are fantastic.
questions: Are the classmates from one country?
Are the professors good?

ar: دروسي صعبة جداً لكني سعيد هنا.
en: My classes are very difficult but I am happy here.
questions: Are the classes easy or difficult?
Does he enjoy his studies?

ar: أعيش في سكن جامعي حديث يسمى سكن سيمونز.
en: My dormitory is a modern building called Simmons Hall.
questions: What is the name of the dorm?
Is it old or modern?

ar: السكن الجامعي في أمريكا كبير ويعتبر جزءاً من الجامعة.
en: Dorms in the U.S. are big and part of the university.
questions: Are dorms small or big in the U.S.?
Are they part of the university?

ar: أعيش في الطابق الثامن وأشارك الغرفة مع طالب آخر.
en: I live on the eighth floor and share a room with another student.
questions: Which floor does he live on?
Does he live alone?

ar: غرفتنا فيها تسع نوافذ ومكتب وإطلالة جميلة على النهر.
en: Our room has nine windows, a desk, and a beautiful view of the river.
questions: How many windows are in the room?
What can they see from the desk?

ar: في السكن توجد صالات ومسرح رياضي وأنشطة ممتعة.
en: The dorm has lounges, a movie theater, and fun activities.
questions: What facilities are in the dorm?
Is there a movie theater?

ar: أنا أستمتع بالحياة هنا وأصدقائي يدرسون بجد.
en: I enjoy living here and my friends study hard.
questions: Does he like living in the dorm?
Do students study or relax only?
